title: The Weight of the Key
vote_a: Lock the door to protect the present
vote_b: Open the gate to release the past
recap: Maya and Leo discover that the library is a broken memory, not just a building. Mrs. Adel reveals that the clock has broken time, causing the strange events to happen. A new word appears in the book, and Maya must decide how to use the key before the ceiling collapses.
